claim_text: Ecological information has regime-dependent predictive value for sparse water-quality reconstruction
primary_scenario: same-month primary plus preregistered secondary missingness families
fail_condition: no reproducible matched difference across regimes
non_claim_note: predictive and descriptive; no causal interpretation

claim_text: A shared ecology-time representation transfers a source-observed target analyte to some held-out HUC6 basins
fail_condition: fewer than 2 of 3 analytes meet the feasibility gate

claim_text: K=5 target support improves reconstruction relative to the source-only-selected simple baseline
fail_condition: K=5 fails the >=10% gate or is worse than K=0
non_claim_note: does not imply universal few-shot benefit

claim_text: Transfer gains are present in at least three of five held-out HUC6 tasks
fail_condition: fewer than 3 of 5 tasks have the preregistered direction

claim_text: True target support adds information beyond value and site shuffles
fail_condition: true support does not beat both shuffles

claim_text: K=5 is no worse than K=0 and K=1 for the primary aggregate
No primary analyte/HUC6 cell worsens by more than 5% while pooled success is claimed
non_claim_note: pooled averages cannot erase local failures

claim_text: Matched graph, no-message, and no-ecology controls identify whether topology has incremental value
fail_condition: no matched evidence or inconsistent direction
non_claim_note: topology is not a contribution by model name

claim_text: Val-only empirical calibration changes coverage and interval width in analyte- and basin-dependent ways
fail_condition: calibration or width cannot be recomputed
non_claim_note: coverage alone is not a success criterion

claim_text: Uncertainty ranking supports stable monitoring blind spots
fail_condition: fewer than two independent tools or indicators pass
non_claim_note: no blind-spot or active-sampling claim without a new gate

claim_text: The direction replicates in an independently selected external basin
fail_condition: external direction fails or requires retuning
non_claim_note: external selection and graph audit are future pending

claim_text: All target-HUC6 labels outside K support cells remain hidden during adaptation
fail_condition: any forbidden-label perturbation changes inputs or selection
non_claim_note: visibility and identity are part of the claim

claim_text: The source-observed target-analyte route has a legal native-unit K=0 output
fail_condition: output scale uses target-HUC6 labels or unregistered target priors
non_claim_note: this claim does not extend to the blocked target-unseen-analyte route

claim_text: The corrected Stage-2A same-analyte diagnostic is reproducible but does not establish cross-analyte transfer
fail_condition: diagnostic is presented as held-out-analyte evidence
non_claim_note: prior exposure is acknowledged; no positive transfer inference

claim_text: The independent external case is not used for model selection or endpoint changes
fail_condition: external data influence tuning or endpoint choice
non_claim_note: external validation remains pending and unverified
